cards.title: Meta Releases Llama-Series MoE Model: 816B Total / 42B Active Parameters, Multimodal, Coding-Optimized
cards.why_it_matters: This is Meta's largest open-weight release to date—a frontier MoE model with multimodal inputs and agentic coding focus that the whole field will benchmark and build on.
cards.summary: The model (checkpoint: Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B) uses 62 transformer layers with 256 experts per MoE block, routing 8 experts per token (~42B active parameters), with 97% of parameters in experts. Accepts image, audio, and video inputs via dedicated encoders. BF16 checkpoint is ~1.5TB; NVFP4 variant runs on a single B200 node. Optimized for agentic coding: multi-file refactoring, debugging, and tool use over long contexts.

cards.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX.3 Image Klein: Multi-Reference Image Editing with Layout Control
cards.why_it_matters: Unified text-to-image, multi-reference image-to-image, and bounding-box layout control in a single distilled checkpoint with 2-second H100 inference is a practical capability upgrade for generative image pipelines.
cards.summary: FLUX.3 Image Klein ships two open checkpoints supporting text-to-image, multi-reference image-to-image (referenced as <ref_image_N> in prompts), and JSON bounding-box layout control on a normalized 0–1000 scale. The distilled checkpoint generates 1024×1024 images in about 2 seconds on H100 at 16 steps. NVFP4 and FP8 weights supported. Integrated as a Modular Diffusers pipeline with LoRA training scripts included.

cards.title: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini 4 Argon: Frontier Model Claiming #1 on Vals Index for Enterprise Tasks
cards.why_it_matters: A flagship Google DeepMind model release with documented real-world engineering impact (including internal Google deployments) is a must-track event for any AI/ML practitioner.
cards.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is globally available via API at $2/M input and $10/M output tokens. It ranks #1 on the Vals Index across finance, coding, legal, and tax benchmarks. Documented internal results include: 35%+ increase in agentic code submissions, ~33% reduction in rollbacks, 40% cut in in-memory session prep time for ADK, 2.3x speedup on xTB quantum chemistry, and 2.85x inference speedup on Gemma 4 E2B via vLLM.

cards.title: IBM Releases Granite Switch 4.1: Multi-Adapter Model Combining Chat, Safety Decisions, and ASR
cards.why_it_matters: The Activated LoRA architecture enabling KV-cache sharing across adapters is a practically important inference efficiency technique worth tracking for multi-task deployment scenarios.
cards.summary: Granite-Switch-4.1-8B and -30B compose a general Decision aLoRA, a Guardian safety aLoRA (claimed to outperform several named closed decision models on safety tasks), and Granite-Speech-5.0-Turbo-CTC ASR into one endpoint at roughly base-model VRAM cost. Cache-efficient Activated LoRAs reuse KV cache across adapter switches. The 30B model reportedly outperformed a 27B competitor on a 5-step RAG workflow. Community adapter composition is supported.

cards.title: Google DeepMind's Antigravity Agentic Platform Finds Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Candidate
cards.why_it_matters: Antigravity demonstrates a concrete agentic science workflow compressing multi-database biological search into a single session—a model for how AI agents can accelerate wet-lab-adjacent research pipelines.
cards.summary: Google Antigravity is an agentic science workbench enabling multi-turn, researcher-steered discovery sessions. Using ProtNLM—a model predicting biological function from amino acid sequences—it scanned millions of unannotated UniProt entries. Researchers identified a novel antimicrobial peptide candidate with predicted activity against respiratory-tract-infection pathogens in Streptococcus pseudopneumoniae; the lead is now in wet-lab validation.

cards.title: NVIDIA & AI4Bharat Release 2.8T-Token Indic Pretraining Corpus with Open Pipeline
cards.why_it_matters: Massive open multilingual corpora with reproducible generation pipelines are directly actionable for researchers building or fine-tuning models on low-resource languages, and this is the largest open synthetic Indic dataset to date.
cards.summary: Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1 covers all 22 constitutionally recognized Indian languages across 34 language-script configurations: 2,601B native-script tokens and 224.6B romanized tokens (Gemma-4 tokenizer). Content spans translated math, code, and QA material. The open pipeline includes prompts, LLM workflows, and quality checks with input-grounded verification. Built jointly by NVIDIA and IIT Madras's AI4Bharat lab.

cards.title: LIBERO-PeRM: New Benchmark for Personalized Preference Learning in Robot Manipulation
cards.why_it_matters: Benchmarks that decompose preference learning from task completion are essential infrastructure for embodied-agent researchers working on generalizable, user-adaptive policies.
cards.summary: LIBERO-PeRM introduces 312 tasks across five suites evaluating zero-shot preference following, single-preference learning from demos, sample efficiency, cross-layout generalization, and preference composition/conflict handling. Preferences span motion, skill, and user-profile categories. Results show current VLA policies fail at zero-shot personalization; SFT makes preferences learnable, but generalization and conflict handling remain unsolved.

cards.title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search Finds SOTA Quantum Circuits Across 8 Tasks
cards.why_it_matters: LLMs proposing circuit designs verified by an independent evaluator is a novel co-design paradigm with direct relevance to quantum ML and algorithm optimization research.
cards.summary: An evolutionary framework uses LLMs to propose quantum circuit designs scored by an independent evaluator. Across 8 tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, simulation, and number theory, 7 of 8 results significantly reduce both Toffoli gate and qubit counts versus prior state of the art. The eighth task yields a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion, making the divsteps algorithm viable for reversible arithmetic.

cards.title: PathFM: Flow-Matching Model for Full Trajectory Forecasting Beats Quantile Baselines on Path Metrics
cards.why_it_matters: Capturing joint trajectory distributions rather than marginal quantiles matters for cumulative and extremal forecasting tasks—PathFM's distilled flow-matching approach is a technically credible step forward for time series researchers.
cards.summary: PathFM uses flow matching to generate complete future multivariate trajectories rather than marginal quantiles. A distilled one-to-two-step sampler with shared history attention cache achieves path generation speed comparable to a single quantile-model query. The authors introduce fps-bench (augmenting fev-bench with energy and variogram scores); PathFM achieves the highest aggregate path score on fps-bench among evaluated baselines and sustains long-run variability on chaotic systems where baselines collapse.

cards.title: Theoretical Proof: qLDPC Code States Maintain Exponential CMI Decay Under Local Pauli Noise
cards.why_it_matters: Formal stability guarantees for quantum error-correcting code states under noise are foundational for quantum computing researchers working on LDPC codes and mixed-state phases of matter.
cards.summary: The paper proves that for normalized code-projector states of Z_d qLDPC stabilizer codes under local Pauli noise, conditional mutual information I(A:C|B) decays exponentially with buffer width B in two regimes: weak noise (error clusters must cross buffer) and strong noise (buffer supports no logical operator). It also establishes robustness of Levin-Wen topological entropy and, on finite lattices of size n, implies a constant-layer quasi-local Petz recovery channel of range O(poly(log n)/ε).

cards.title: Researcher Claims Neural Networks Are 'Clean': Superposition in InceptionV1 Was Architectural Artifact
cards.why_it_matters: If the canonical polysemanticity/superposition evidence that drove the field toward sparse autoencoders was misread, it fundamentally changes the interpretability research agenda for every ML researcher.
cards.summary: After months studying neurons and circuits, the author argues the landmark polysemanticity evidence in InceptionV1 resulted from architectural failure rather than a general superposition learning principle. With standard architectural improvements and no change to model size or training data, 99–100% of neurons in InceptionV1's last layer became easily interpretable. The author proposes 'recursive generalization' as the correct motif and argues networks can be studied directly without SAE-style unfolding.
